before.scope: VirtualQueryEx metadata for resident private pages only; no process memory bytes read. Shared pages and nonresident-only regions are excluded.

snapshot.limits: Outermost observed heap API calls only; excludes nested allocator requests, pre-attach and out-of-scope allocations. This must be the only interceptor on the owned process. Requested bytes are not private working set. Instrumentation may change allocation behaviour.

correlation.limits: Caller module is not resource ownership. Mixed pages and uncovered bytes remain unassigned. Page and allocation snapshots are not atomic; no working-set acceptance is inferred.
